articles.summary: The great travel backpack vs. tote debate has one very satisfying answer: it depends on your trip. A hands-free backpack can make airport connections and sightseeing days feel infinitely more manageable. A tote keeps essentials within easy reach and transitions beautifully from the terminal to a lunch reservation to your beach chair. And sometimes? Bringing both means you're excellent at planning ahead. Here are a few favorites to help you find the right travel companion: Travel Backpacks: Your Hands-free Best Friend For Maximum Organization: XL Clarion Backpack Some trips involve a charger, headphones, snacks, an extra layer, a book, three things you promised to carry for someone else, and approximately 47 tiny essentials. The XL Clarion Backpack is ready to handle it all. At 19.5” high, this extra large backpack gives everything a place thanks to five exterior zip compartments, two side pockets, and an interior filled with six slip pockets, a pen slip, and a zip pocket. An interior carabiner clip offers another handy spot for keys or essentials you don't want buried, while adjustable shoulder straps and an adjustable chest strap make this women's backpack especially appealing for travel days when you expect to be on the move. In other words: your hands are free, your essentials are sorted, and nobody has to dig to find what they need. 🌟Pro tip: Take your backpack organization to the next level with a makeup bag, jewelry case and more fun organizing accessories for your next trip. For Plenty of Space Without Going XL: Large Clarion Backpack Want the organizational personality of the XL Clarion in a slightly slimmer silhouette? Meet the Large Clarion Backpack. It shares many of the same travel-friendly details, including adjustable shoulder and chest straps, two exterior side pockets and plenty of interior organization. Four exterior zip compartments make frequently used items easy to separate, while six interior slip pockets, a pen slip, zip pocket and carabiner clip help keep the main compartment from becoming a free-for-all. This large but lightweight backpack is a smart choice when your itinerary includes airport corridors, sightseeing, public transportation, or any other situation where hands-free wins. When Your Packing List Has a Packing List: XL Bancroft Backpack There's prepared, and then there's "XL Bancroft" prepared. The XL Bancroft Backpack shows off its storage prowess with three spacious zip compartments, a dedicated laptop zip pocket, a tablet sleeve, and expandable side pockets designed to accommodate a variety of water bottle sizes. There's also a trolley sleeve, so you can slip the backpack over your luggage handle for an easy-carry option while rushing through the airport. And when your packing list grows? A zip expansion panel at the base adds two inches of depth. Because sometimes “just the essentials” develops its own definition halfway through packing. Thoughtful details continue inside, with multiple slip pockets, a zip pocket and a pen slip, plus a front ring for keys or charms. For longer travel days or adventures that require more gear, this backpack understands the assignment. For Business Trips and Weekend Departures: Large Bancroft Backpack The Large Bancroft Backpack lives at the intersection of polished and practical. It accommodates up to a 15” laptop and includes three compartments, a front zip pocket, multiple interior slip pockets, and a zip pocket. A trolley sleeve makes navigating with all of your luggage much easier, while two side slip pockets, keep grab-and-go necessities close. There's even a front ring for keychains or charms, because practical does not mean personality-free. For travelers moving between airport, hotel, and work meetings, this backpack keeps technology and everyday essentials organized without looking like you borrowed your hiking bag for the occasion. 🌟Pro tip: Add a coordinating cord organizer pouch to wrangle your chargers, earbuds and other tech accessories so charging your phone doesn't require a frantic five-minute search. For Walking-Heavy Adventures: Large Berkhill Backpack City wandering, museum hopping, or a full day exploring somewhere new are all backpack territory. The lightweight, casual Large Berkhill Backpack is designed for an active day, with adjustable straps, two exterior zip pockets, two side pockets and a compartment that accommodates up to a 15” laptop. A trolley sleeve adds airport convenience, while interior slip and zip pockets keep smaller belongings under control. If your ideal women's backpack for travel needs to move easily from flight day to sightseeing day, the Berkhill makes a compelling case. Tote Bags for Travel: Get the Best of Both Worlds Backpacks may win for hands-free convenience, but totes have their own travel superpowers: wide openings, easy access, and the ability to move from travel bag to everyday carryall without missing a beat. For Airport Organization: Knollton Tote Bag Our Knollton Tote Bag was made with travel in mind. Its spacious silhouette includes a zip main compartment, dedicated zip laptop pocket, and back zip pocket with a webbing trolley sleeve inside. It holds a 15" laptop, while three interior slip pockets and a zip pocket help organize everything from travel documents to chargers. If you're searching for a travel tote bag with a zipper that feels polished enough for work trips but roomy enough for weekend departures, the Knollton is ready for boarding. For Spacious, Simple Carrying: Marston Grand Tote Bag The Marston Grand Tote Bag keeps things refreshingly uncomplicated. Its roomy interior gives you space for the extras that inevitably join the trip, while an interior zip pocket and key loop keep smaller necessities easy to find. Its generous 21.75” top width also makes it easy to reach inside when you need something quickly, a definite advantage when your passport is somewhere in there and you're finally at the front of the TSA line. For travelers who like a spacious women's travel tote without an abundance of compartments, Marston keeps the experience simple. 🌟Pro tip: When you're the kind of traveler who always says “throw it in, we might need it!”, use small, medium, and large pouches to make every little thing easy to find. For Two Looks in One: Hathaway Tote Bag Packing space is precious. A reversible bag? We respect the efficiency. The Hathaway Tote Bag features a reversible design, quilted cotton lining, exterior and interior slip pockets, and a hidden magnetic closure. Its versatile shape works beautifully for vacation days when you want a lighter carryall for shopping, sightseeing, or dinner. And because it reverses, changing up your look doesn't require finding room for another bag. Your suitcase approves. For a Vera Bradley Classic: The Original Vera Tote The Original Vera Tote knows a thing or two about going places. Its roomy interior includes six slip pockets, while exterior slip and zip pockets make frequently used essentials easier to grab. A zip closure keeps the main compartment secure, and quilted cotton lining brings that unmistakable Vera Bradley feel. With a 12” handle drop and generous proportions, it's an easygoing women's travel tote bag for road trips, weekend getaways, and days when you would simply rather carry than wear your bag. 🌟Pro tip: When you're packing the big suitcase, add our soft cotton Small Original Vera Tote, which is just the right size to bring your style on the road. For Zip-It-and-Go Ease: The Original Zip Tote Bag For anyone who loves the classic tote experience but prefers everything securely zipped inside, there's the Original Zip Tote Bag. This roomy carryall features a full zip closure, 12” handle drop, exterior slip pocket, two interior slip pockets, and an interior zip pocket. It's versatile enough to move from travel day to everyday life long after you've unpacked. If a travel tote bag with a zipper is high on your wish list, this one makes a strong argument for Team Tote. Keep Track of All of the Little Things: 3 Pouch Organizer Set Whichever bag you choose, organization gets even easier with the 3 Pouch Organizer Set. The set includes three zippered pouches in large, medium, and small sizes, making it easy to create your own system inside a backpack or tote. Think tech accessories in one, personal essentials in another, and all those tiny things that otherwise disappear precisely when you need them in the third. The Power Move: Bring the Backpack and the Tote Too! Who says you have to choose? Pairing a backpack with a tote gives you flexibility throughout the trip. Use your backpack for hands-free airport navigation or walking-heavy days, then switch to your tote when you want easier access to essentials or a more relaxed carryall. A tote can also hold those last-minute additions that mysteriously appear between leaving home and reaching your gate. When it comes to your next trip, sometimes the answer is both! articles.summary: 08/25/26 The Hidden Costs of “Saving” on Fasteners: Simpson Strong-Tie Warns Customers About the Dangers of Using Unapproved Fasteners When Installing Connectors Pleasanton, Calif. — After witnessing an uptick in installers substituting alternative fasteners for connector installation, Simpson Strong-Tie is urging customers to use only specified and approved fasteners when installing its connectors. Using unapproved fasteners can lead to failed inspections, voided warranties, costly litigation and even structural failure. “Switching to a lower-priced fastener may save money up front, but it can be a costly and potentially hazardous decision,” said Aram Khachadourian, Engineering Manager, Research & Development, Fasteners and Mechanical Anchors for Simpson Strong-Tie. “Our connectors undergo rigorous testing using specific fasteners. Substituting a smaller or shorter fastener than what is shown in our catalog puts the integrity of the connection at risk. Likewise, using untested proprietary fasteners — even those with similar dimensions — can significantly change performance and could result in reduced structural capacity or other unintended failures.” Simpson Strong-Tie connectors have been designed and tested for use with specific types and sizes of nails and Simpson Strong-Tie Connector Screws. The specified quantity, type and size of fastener must be installed in the correct holes in the connector to achieve published loads. Other factors such as fastener material and finish are also important. Simpson will not guarantee connector performance when alternate fasteners are used. Incorrect fastener selection or installation can result in: · Voided warranties: The Simpson Strong-Tie Limited Warranty is void and does not apply to failure or damage caused by the use of a product with any fasteners other than those prescribed by Simpson Strong-Tie. · Potential inspection rejection: Substitution of non-specified fasteners may result in a red-tagged job that could require the installer to provide independent engineering substantiation to satisfy the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ), potentially resulting in project delays or additional costs. · Increased repair cost: The installer may incur increased costs associated with the removal of rejected fasteners, the replacement of new fasteners and connectors, and the cost to repair or replace the wood damaged by the improper installation. · Liability and litigation: The use of unapproved fasteners may transfer the liability of connection load values and performance away from Simpson and onto the installer, specifier, or engineer of record, resulting in greater exposure to potential litigation. · Structural failure: The use of unapproved fasteners may result in the connection failing to meet the intended allowable load. Such conditions may have severe life and safety implications, not only during construction, but also during loading events throughout the life of the structure. Contractors who have already installed Simpson Strong-Tie connectors with unapproved screws or nails should immediately contact the engineer of record to design and approve a remedy. For questions about approved fasteners for connectors, installers should reach out the Engineering Technical Support Team at 800-999-5099. For more information, visit www.strongtie.com. About Simpson Strong-Tie Company Inc. Simpson Strong-Tie is the world leader in structural solutions — products and technology that help people design and build safer, stronger homes, buildings, and communities. As a pioneer in the building industry, we have an unmatched passion for problem solving through skillful engineering and thoughtful innovation. Our structural systems, research and rigorous testing enable us to design code-listed, value-engineered solutions for a multitude of applications in wood, steel, and concrete structures. Our dedication to pursuing ever-better construction products and technology and to surrounding our customers with exceptional service and support has been core to our mission since 1956. articles.summary: The best fall purse doesn't have to carry your entire life from September until Christmas. This season, smaller silhouettes, tactile materials, and playful finishing touches make a strong case for carrying only what you need, and making every detail count. Think polished leather with denim. Soft corduroy against a crisp jacket. A silk scarf knotted around a handle. A tiny bear hanging from a bag that otherwise means business. When it comes to handbag styling, there's no single formula. Pick the shape, texture, and extras that feel like you, then make them your own. Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag: Your Outfit's Very Capable Plus-One Our Clara Convertible Shoulder Bag in leather has that polished, pulled-together look that plays especially well with fall layers. Its clean silhouette makes it an easy match for everything from wide-leg denim and loafers to a midi skirt and tall boots. And because the adjustable strap is removable, you can change how the bag sits with your look. Carry it closer to the shoulder when you want a classic profile, or add the longer strap when your outfit calls for a different proportion. Inside, a zip pocket keeps smaller essentials together without overcomplicating things. Pair it with the Small Deluxe Tab Wallet in leather for an equally streamlined companion. At just 4 ¼" wide, it keeps your ID, cards, and cash organized in a compact shape that leaves plenty of room for the rest of your essentials. How we'd style it: When it comes to styling a leather purse for fall, choose tonal neutrals, a favorite knit and one unexpected accent like patterned shoes, statement earrings, or a silk scarf. Polished does not have to mean predictable. Mini Clara in Corduroy: Texture Is the Outfit The Mini Clara purse in corduroy taps into one of fall's great pleasures: texture. Its curved silhouette feels modern, while corduroy adds a little touch of softness and nostalgia to the mix. At 9" wide, it stays firmly in small-bag territory, with two interior credit card slips that make it easier to travel light. The compact proportions also make it a natural match for fall's more substantial pieces like oversized outerwear, chunky sweaters, or relaxed denim, without competing with them. How we'd style it: Let the corduroy do the talking. Pair a corduroy purse with smoother fabrics like denim, wool, or leather to create contrast. Small Original Vera Tote: A Classic Rethought Some classics don't need reinventing. They just need the proportions tweaked. The Small Original Vera Tote in full-grain leather brings the familiar Original Vera Tote shape into a more compact silhouette. The leather gives it a refined fall feel, while the exterior slip pocket and six interior slip pockets make organization easy without turning the bag into a filing cabinet. With an 11 ½" square body and a wider 16 ¼" top, it has enough presence to anchor an outfit while still feeling lighter and more streamlined than a larger tote. Prefer pattern and quilting? The Small Original Vera Tote is also available in classic premium cotton with a quilted cotton lining, giving you another way to interpret the same iconic silhouette. How we'd style it: Use a leather tote as a grounding piece with prints and layered color, or let a soft quilted cotton tote become the focal point of a simpler look. Your bag doesn't have to match. Maisie Handbag in Denim: Denim Does Dress Up The denim Maisie Handbag is proof that classics have all the fun. Its compact 8" wide silhouette has a clean, timeless shape, but denim gives it a more relaxed point of view. That combination makes it especially easy to style for fall, when wardrobes naturally start mixing structured pieces with softer, more casual layers. Finish with two small exterior slip pockets to keep frequently reached-for items close, while the zip closure keeps the silhouette neat. How we'd style it: That old rule about not mixing denim? Consider this your permission slip to ignore it. Pair a denim purse with corduroy. Add a denim crossbody to a trench. Carry a patchwork denim tote bag with a dress and boots. Or try denim-on-denim if that's your thing! Original 100 Handbag: The One That Started Something There are throwbacks, and then there are originals. The quilted cotton Original 100 Handbag brings back the silhouette that helped start the Vera Bradley story, thoughtfully crafted for the way we carry now. It features three exterior slip pockets, five interior slip pockets, and a soft quilted cotton lining, balancing recognizable Vera Bradley design with plenty of everyday function. How we'd style it: For fall, the Original 100's classic shape gives you room to play with pattern. Pair it with solid separates, mix it with another print or take the maximalist route and keep going. Amanda Shoulder Bag: Add New Shape to the Rotation The Amanda Shoulder Bag in premium quilted cotton has a slim, vertical silhouette that adds a different proportion to fall looks. It's stylishly spacious without feeling oversized, with an exterior slip pocket, two interior slip pockets, and an interior zip pocket. And there's another texture joining the story: the Amanda Shoulder Bag will also be available in Velvet later in the fall, just in time for your holiday celebration. Because once the calendar starts filling up, a little velvet makes a very good argument for itself. How we'd style it: Pair it with straight-leg jeans and a sweater, a long coat and boots, or whatever combination is currently winning the bedroom-chair audition. How to Style a Handbag Without Overthinking It Wondering how to style your handbag so it feels more personal? Start with the part that has absolutely nothing to do with rules: choose something you like. Then add another thing you like! That's where scarves and bag charms come in. They're an easy way to change the attitude of a favorite handbag from one outfit or one day to the next. Square Silk Scarf: Tie It Up The Square Silk Scarf is printed silk in a versatile 25 ½" square, giving you plenty of ways to make it part of your look. Knot it around a handbag handle. Tie it into a loose bow. Wrap it around your neck and let the bag stay simple. Style it in your hair. There isn't a test later. A silk scarf also creates a particularly interesting contrast against rich materials like leather, denim, and corduroy. Smooth meets textured. Polished meets playful. Everybody wins. Bag Charms: Your Handbag Has Hobbies Now Bag charms have a way of turning a handbag into your handbag. They add color, movement, texture, and, occasionally, a tiny bear, all of which seem important. The Original Tote Bag Charm takes an instantly recognizable tote silhouette and shrinks it down to a playful accessory, complete with classic quilted cotton and a zip closure. Consider it a Vera Bradley tote for your Vera Bradley tote! For something a little softer, the adorable Bitty Bear Bag Charm brings personality to handbags, totes, and keys alike. Available in premium cotton and corduroy, it's an especially fun way to bring another fall texture into your look. Want something that gets noticed? The Beaded Bird Bag Charm adds a decorative, conversation-starting detail with an easy-to-attach hinge ring. The Bird Earbud Bag Charm proves a charming accessory can have a job, too. Its zippered design accommodates most earbuds, while the patchwork style makes it an easy companion for the season's casual looks. Your earbuds have officially moved into a nicer apartment. And for a floral moment that isn't remotely concerned with the temperature outside, the Floral Bag Charm brings a pop of color and movement with its elongated faux-leather design. This Fall, Follow Your Own Bag Rules Leather or corduroy. Denim or soft cotton. Compact shoulder bag or small tote. One charm or enough charms to require introductions. The right fall fashion handbag is the one that works with your style. Start with a silhouette you're drawn to, play with the season's richer materials, then add scarves, charms, and other details until it feels unmistakably yours. SHOP ALL FALL HANDBAGS & ACCESSORIES
